name: context-enum-two-production-variants
body: The enum doc's statement that the save boundary runs no whole-model cardinality pass, and so names no context, is true only while no save path runs a whole-model pass: restore a `Save` variant (or add a third context) if a save boundary ever regains one. Retired by phase-2 task-16 once the boundary's cardinality call left; `Lint` and `MergeStrength` are the production contexts, and `validate_cardinalities` branches only on `MergeStrength`.
